2609.20147.title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
2609.20147.paper_summary: Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.
2609.20147.paper_summary_zh: 皮質低代謝量由氟脫氧葡萄糖正子發射斷層掃描（FDG-PET）測量，是一個對於癡呆診斷的高度敏感生物標記。然而，高昂的成本、輻射暴露和有限的可及性限制了其臨床實用性。雖然來自磁共振成像（MRI）的跨模態合成提供了一個有前景的替代方案，但現有的體積生成方法並未明確考慮高度摺疊的皮質幾何結構，而疾病相關模式主要存在於此。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了一種新穎的基於表面的擴散橋接框架DB-SUiT，用於MRI到PET的轉換，該框架在皮質流形上原生運行。一個條件性的球形U型視覺Transformer（SUiT）專門設計用來建模複雜的跨模態關係，同時保留表面拓撲。它結合了球形卷積編碼器以進行多尺度表面特徵提取，並使用瓶頸Transformer來捕捉長距離空間依賴性，同時納入人口統計和皮層下條件以精煉合成。在兩個數據集上進行評估，包括不同癡呆類型的受試者，DB-SUiT顯示出高保真度的合成，顯著超越其他基準。在自動癡呆分類中，合成的PET表面相比MRI提高了14.2%的性能，PET體積提高了11.3%，接近真實PET表面的性能。在一項盲讀者研究中，合成的PET達到了85.5%的診斷準確率，而MRI為75.8%，真實PET為95.2%。這進一步展示了跨隊列和跨病理的泛化，因為該模型在未經重新訓練的外部隊列上進行評估，該隊列包括在訓練期間未代表的癡呆亞型。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT獲得。
